crossRefs.note: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
After some days Paul said to Barnabas, “Let’s return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed…
but Paul chose Silas and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.
He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.
Having spent some time there, he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing…
When he had gone through those parts, and had encouraged them with many words, he came into Greece.
When they had come to him, he said to them, “You yourselves know, from the first day that I set foot in Asia, how I was…
I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.
For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;
that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the…
who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.
For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not…

translations.web: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.
translations.bsb: Apart from these external trials, I face daily the pressure of my concern for all the churches.
translations.kjv: Beside those things that are without, that which cometh upon me daily, the care of all the churches.
translations.asv: Besides those things that are without, there is that which presseth upon me daily, anxiety for all the churches.
